# hpe_morpheus_cluster (Data Source)



`hpe_morpheus_cluster` data source provides details about an existing Morpheus cluster by `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_cluster" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_cluster" "example" {
  name = "Example name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `name` (String) The name of the cluster.
